description_en: Withdraws certificate application orders that are pending verification or under review
description_zh: 撤回待验证、审核中的证书申请订单
name: CancelOrderRequest

parameters.help_en:
The order ID.
You can obtain this ID by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html.

OrderId is the certificate application order ID, not CertificateId. Only orders in the CHECKING state can be withdrawn. To obtain a withdrawable order, you must first create a certificate application by calling CreateCertificateForPackageRequest, which requires a purchased certificate resource plan
parameters.help_zh:
订单ID。
此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html获取。

OrderId 是证书申请订单 ID（非 CertificateId），仅 CHECKING 状态的订单可撤回，获取可撤回订单需先通过 CreateCertificateForPackageRequest 创建证书申请（依赖已购买的证书资源包）
parameters.name: order_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
